name: Hazardous Waste Characterization and Treatment
description: Comprehensive instruction in hazardous waste management, integrating foundational and advanced topics; definitions, classification, and characterization of hazardous wastes; risk assessment; and environmental legislation; site assessment, safe handling, proper storage, transportation, and disposal techniques, covering chemical, physical, and biological treatment methods; groundwater contamination, landfill design, and resource recovery strategies; emerging trends such as artificial intelligence, biomethanation, and pyrolysis ensuring a modern, holistic approach to sustainable waste minimization and environmental protection.
